definitions.explanation: The strands growing from the head.

examples.japanese: {髪|かみ}を{切|き}りに{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to get my hair cut.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}、{髪|かみ}を{洗|あら}ってから{出|で}かける。
examples.english: I wash my hair in the morning before going out.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}が{強|つよ}くて、{髪|かみ}がぼさぼさになった。
examples.english: The wind was strong and my hair got all messy.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{長|なが}い{髪|かみ}を{後|うし}ろで{一|ひと}つに{結|むす}んで、{毎日|まいにち}{学校|がっこう}に{来|く}る。
examples.english: She ties her long hair back in a ponytail and comes to school every day.

notes:
{髪|かみ} refers specifically to head hair (not body hair).

HOMOPHONES:
- {髪|かみ}: hair (head)
- {紙|かみ}: paper
- {神|かみ}: god
(Context usually makes the meaning clear.)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {髪|かみ}を{切|き}る: to cut hair
- {髪|かみ}を{洗|あら}う: to wash hair
- {髪|かみ}を{染|そ}める: to dye hair
- {髪|かみ}を{伸|の}ばす: to grow hair out
- {髪|かみ}を{結|むす}ぶ: to tie up hair

COMPOUNDS:
- {髪型|かみがた}: hairstyle
- {髪の毛|かみのけ}: hair (individual strands)
- {白髪|しらが}: gray/white hair
- {前髪|まえがみ}: bangs, fringe
- {黒髪|くろかみ}: black hair
- {長髪|ちょうはつ}: long hair
- {短髪|たんぱつ}: short hair
